newsitem.title: USA: Goshen Savings says conversion filing approved.
newsitem.headline: Goshen Savings says conversion filing approved.

text.p: Goshen Savings Bank said Thursday the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision approved its application to convert from a federal mutual savings bank to a federal stock savings bank.
Goshen said the application is subject to approval by its depositors at a special meeting.
The bank said it formed a holding company, GSB Financial Corp, which will offer to sell common shares to present and former depositors of Goshen Savings in a subscription offering expiring June 20.

Goshen said it will offer up to 1,955,000 shares at $10.00 per share. It said the number of shares is subject to increase to about 2.2 million shares under certain circumstances and, depending on market conditions and availability of shares, it may sell shares via a public offering.
A company spokesman said the company would increase the number of shares to be offered depending on market conditions.
